# dsm_event_task (Data Source)

Reads an existing boot or shutdown task from DSM Task Scheduler.

Reading a task executes nothing, so this data source is not gated behind `allow_task_execution`. It is a useful way to audit what a NAS already runs unattended on every restart.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Useful for auditing what a NAS already runs unattended on every restart.
data "dsm_event_task" "on_boot" {
  name = "restore-mounts"
}

output "boot_task_runs_as_root" {
  description = "DSM records an event task's owner by uid; 0 is root."
  value       = data.dsm_event_task.on_boot.owner_uid == 0
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Task name to look up.

### Read-Only

- `command` (String) Shell command DSM executes.
- `depends_on_tasks` (List of String) Names of tasks that must finish before this one starts.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the task is active.
- `event` (String) System event that triggers the task: `bootup` or `shutdown`.
- `id` (String) Task name, which is also DSM's identifier for an event task.
- `notify_email` (String) Address DSM emails when the task runs, or null when notification is disabled.
- `notify_on_failure` (Boolean) Whether DSM notifies only on failure rather than after every run.
- `owner_uid` (Number) Numeric uid DSM records for the owning account. `0` is root.
- `user` (String) Account DSM runs the command as.
